js: (async () => { const v = document.querySelector('.player video'); if (!v) return 'pas de lecteur'; v.muted = true; await v.play().catch(e => 0); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return JSON.stringify({t: v.currentTime.toFixed(1), dur: Math.round(v.duration), pistes: v.textTracks.length, chapitres: document.querySelectorAll('.player .chap').length}); })()
